_comment: Single source of truth for tickers with known data-quality problems. Entries with exclude=true are filtered out at data load, so the dashboard, predictions and backtests all ignore them consistently. Set exclude=false to bring one back once its issue is resolved.

S.reason: Delisted (Sprint/T-Mobile merger). Last report 2019-10-25, 2503 days behind the leading edge. No real earnings dates.
S.resolution: Drop permanently, or keep excluded as historical-only.

JWN.reason: Taken private. Last report 2025-01-24, 585 days behind the leading edge. No real earnings dates; all 56 are low-confidence estimates.
JWN.resolution: Drop permanently, or keep excluded as historical-only.

SKX.reason: Acquired. Last report 2025-07-25, 403 days behind the leading edge. No real earnings dates; all 58 are low-confidence estimates.
SKX.resolution: Drop permanently, or keep excluded as historical-only.

BRK/B.reason: 10 quarters missing from the source data (Q2'17-Q3'19). Rows are treated as consecutive, so TTM and QoQ silently bridge a 2.5-year hole and Index alignment is off by 10 quarters vs every other ticker.
BRK/B.resolution: Backfill the 10 missing quarters, then set exclude=false. Do NOT relabel the Report column to close the gap - the existing labels are correct.

BABA.reason: WATCH ONLY - not excluded. One suspect earnings date: rows 783-784 are 55 days apart (2026-03-19 -> 2026-05-13) where every other spacing in the file is 84-112. Financial data (EPS/Revenue/Price) is sound, so analysis is unaffected.

EA.reason: WATCH ONLY - not excluded. Sheet carries a 'Buyout' note at Q2'26. Data is current, but the ticker will stop reporting.
